03 / About

Every cut has
a purpose.

I’m Damilola Adeluwoye, a video editor focused on turning footage into clear, compelling stories. My approach combines thoughtful pacing, visual flow, and editing decisions that support the message and audience experience.

Whether you’re a creator building a channel, a brand sharing an idea, or a team capturing an event, the aim is the same: make the video feel intentional and easy to connect with.

Story firstEvery edit should have a clear purpose and flow.
Audience-awareChoose pacing and presentation for the platform and viewer.
Detail mattersSound, captions, timing, and clean finishing all count.
04 / Process

Simple from brief
to delivery.

STEP 01

Brief

Align on goals, audience, references, platform, and deliverables.

STEP 02

Edit

Shape footage into a clear story with intentional pacing.

STEP 03

Review

Review the cut and share consolidated feedback within the agreed scope.

STEP 04

Deliver

Receive final exports in the agreed formats and sizes.
